items.title: Curtis Mitchell Interview, 1996-04-02
items.q: Danny White had a band, and they had Irvin Bannister, Ernest Hollins, Hulk, Henry Hawkins, the trumpet player... And so he got this job on St. Charles Avenue with the club Sands... Ernest Hollins told him, so why not get Curtis, man. See, I was the last one in Danny's band.

ctx.x: And later on I sang in another quartet, me and his brother was in the same quartet, Henry, you know, his brother Henry.
Okay, I think I remember him telling me about Henry. What school did you go to when you were, I guess it was a grammar school or when you? Yeah, yeah.

items.title: Curtis Mitchell Interview, 1996-04-02
items.q: me and his brother was in the same quartet

ctx.x: Yeah. But he never did sing that quartet.
And later on I sang in another quartet, me and his brother was in the same quartet, Henry, you know, his brother Henry.
